about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos, clips and the map run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); landscape is the same cut at 16:9 for a feed or a screen, with a title-safe margin; story leaves the top bar and the reply field; square is a feed post with the same title-safe margin on every side.
